structured.approach: I read the four contracted inputs (feat.tasks, feat.design, org.data_model, task.repo_access) and the full ap_pipeline code from the tool view, plus data/sample_feed.csv and README.md. I searched the repository for secret, token, password and environment-variable patterns to cover the workbook's "access for the secrets" action. I traced how the new optional feed v3 column paid_date flows through the existing pipeline. csv.DictReader in ingest.parse_feed already passes any header column through, so the smallest ingestion change is none. All changes fall in transform.py (TSK-01), the new delays.py (TSK-02), the version step and the tests, all inside the feat.tasks file budgets. I did not use CodeGraph or the API connectors because the repository is small and the tool view held all the code.

claims.text: The ingestion layer (ingest.parse_feed) needs no change: csv.DictReader keys each row by the header, so a v3 paid_date column reaches each row dict, and a v2 feed simply has no paid_date key
pipeline.py, dq.py, ingest.py and schedule.json (daily, 02:00, Asia/Kolkata) are not changed; the new reason 'paid_date' reaches reject_reasons by itself

transform.to_model is updated additively (TSK-01): it adds _parse_paid_date and PAID_DATE_REASON, keeps the existing try block, signature and (records, rejected) return shape, and rejects a non-blank invalid paid_date with reason 'paid_date'
A new module src/ap_pipeline/delays.py with delays_by_vendor is created (TSK-02), with new tests/test_delays.py; TSK-02 depends on TSK-01
The ap_pipeline version 0.4.0 takes one minor step owned by TSK-01; no __all__ is added
The Invoice data model gains paid_date (date or None), added in feed v3
data/sample_feed.csv is a v2 sample with header invoice_id,vendor,due_date,amount,paid and stays unchanged because it is outside the task budgets
The ap_pipeline source reads no secret or environment variable, and the feature adds no secret, so the lane needs no secret access in any environment
No Databricks or database is used; the repo is on feature/story at 3fcbe1b with write access

open_questions: CQ-DE4-1 (non-blocking): When will feed v3 with paid_date be in production (PQ-6)? It gates release only, not coding. Owner: Product manager / Data engineering lead
CQ-DE4-2 (non-blocking): Should a synthetic v3 sample feed be added later? data/sample_feed.csv stays v2 because it is outside the task budgets. Owner: Data engineering lead
CQ-DE4-3 (non-blocking): Confirm against task.secrets_scope (DE-02, not an input here) that the lane needs no secrets in any environment. Owner: Data engineering lead
CQ-DE4-4 (non-blocking): No feed v3 specification is in the inputs; the column name paid_date is taken from org.data_model and feat.design. Owner: Data modeler
structured.summary: I wrote task.components.md for FEAT-ZD-48600. The ingestion layer needs no code change: the feed v3 paid_date column passes through ingest.parse_feed as it is, and pipeline.run, dq.quality_report and schedule.json stay unchanged. The lane's minimum change set is: update transform.to_model additively (TSK-01), add the new delays.py with delays_by_vendor (TSK-02), make the version step in __init__.py, and add tests in test_pipeline.py and the new test_delays.py. No secrets or Databricks are needed. There are four non-blocking open questions and no blocking ones.
